bib.title: IMAGEBIND: One Embedding Space To Bind Them All

question: Can one joint embedding space across six modalities be learned using only image-paired data, so that unpaired modality pairs align without direct training?
hypothesis: Aligning each modality only to image embeddings leads to emergent alignment between all modalities, and this improves with a stronger image encoder.
contributions: IMAGEBIND: joint embedding of six modalities (image/video, text, audio, depth, thermal, IMU) trained with image-paired data only
Emergent zero-shot classification and retrieval across modalities, and few-shot results
Applications: embedding arithmetic, audio-prompted detection (Detic) and audio-to-image generation (DALLE-2), and use as an evaluation tool for vision models

method.summary: Modality-specific Transformer encoders for audio, depth, thermal and IMU are trained with a symmetric InfoNCE loss to match frozen OpenCLIP ViT-H image and text embeddings, one (image, M) pair type at a time. Text-to-modality alignment emerges without any (modality, text) pairs.
method.task: multimodal contrastive embedding; emergent zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval

datasets.name: AudioSet (unbalanced train)
datasets.preprocessing: 2s clips, 16kHz, 128-bin log mel spectrogram, 25ms Hamming window, 10ms hop

datasets.name: LLVIP
datasets.preprocessing: single-channel thermal; replicated 50x per main text, 25 per Table 9

datasets.name: Ego4D
datasets.preprocessing: 5s clips, 6x2000 IMU; only frames and IMU used

datasets.name: Web image-text (via OpenCLIP)
datasets.source: OpenCLIP ViT-H and text encoder, used pretrained and frozen

datasets.name: Eval: AS-A, ESC-50, Clotho, AudioCaps, VGGSound, SUN-D, NYU-D, LLVIP, Ego4D, IN1K, P365, K400, MSR-VTT 1k-A
datasets.size: test sizes in Table 1 (e.g. ESC 400, Clotho 1045, AudioCaps 796, VGGS 14073, SUN-D 4660, NYU-D 653, LLVIP 15809, Ego4D 68865)
datasets.preprocessing: CLIP default templates for all modalities

other.note: main text says ViT-B for audio and ViT-S for thermal/depth; Table 9 LLVIP column shows 768/12 heads, inconsistent with ViT-S

training.objective: symmetric InfoNCE L_{I,M}+L_{M,I}, in-batch negatives, fixed temperature; one modality pair per minibatch
training.epochs: 64 (AS, SUN, LLVIP), 8 (Ego4D); main text says 32 epochs
training.regularisation: stochastic depth 0.1/0.0/0.0/0.7; gradient clipping 1.0/1.0/5.0/1.0; RandomErase p=0.25; RandAugment 9/0.5; color jitter 0.4; freq masking 12
training.hardware: 32GB V100 or 40GB A100 GPUs (count not stated)

inference.samples: single run; no seeds or variance reported
inference.prompting: default CLIP prompt templates for all modalities
inference.retrieval: cosine similarity on temperature-scaled embeddings; multiple 2s clips uniformly sampled at inference (ceil(5/2)=3 for ESC)

parameters.arithmetic: l2-normalize then sum after scaling each by 0.5

metrics.name: top-1 accuracy
metrics.definition: zero-shot classification by similarity to class-name text embeddings

metrics.name: Recall@K
metrics.definition: text-to-audio/video retrieval; ground truth in top K

eval.protocol: Emergent zero-shot; few-shot uses linear classifiers on frozen features (AdamW; ESC lr 1.6e-3 wd 0.05 50 epochs; SUN lr 1e-2 no wd 60 epochs), k in {1,2,4,8}, same samples for all methods. No seeds or significance tests.

limits: Embeddings are general purpose and lag specialist models; the authors say more research is needed to adapt them per task.
Authors call the model a research prototype not ready for real-world applications.
Joint embeddings limited to concepts in training data: thermal data is outdoor street scenes, depth indoor scenes.
Possible unintentional associations and inherited web biases (App F).
Detection, audio-to-image and arithmetic results are qualitative only.
No seeds, variance, GPU count, compute or wall-clock reported; text says 32 epochs but Table 9 lists 64 (8 for Ego4D).
No fair baseline exists for emergent zero-shot; AudioCLIP baseline is not strictly zero-shot.
